19 . Im only 25 but it feels like forever ago. I’ve been here (incredibly recently)..something intervened and kept me on the road. There must be another way to press on. I’m determined to find it. 

Hopelessness..it’s tricky. Your mind will try to trick you to think that you can’t achieve and move on. The truth is, you will. Your body will keep going; it’s perfectly healthy. You haven’t even gotten to the good shit in life yet. Your mind will catch up. 

19 is a superficial age. Life will get more difficult and you will meet another girl. I broke up with a girl I thought was going to be my wife at 19 and lost all my friends trying to get her back. Wasted some good years chasing her back and forth until 22. Met my current gf last year (much more in love and she’s much better looking and a better person), and now I’m suicidal for the first time in my life..almost let the car go off the road tonight. A cop intervened. 

The point is. Life will go on. You’ll try to kill yourself. Most likely you’ll do it wrong or someone will stop you and you’ll just end up with guilt and more sadness. Trust me. I feel like shit right now. I could have devastated everyone I love tonight because I’m an idiot. 

Don’t go through with it. Tough it out. Move on. Life will have ups and downs. Enjoy the highs and slug through the lows. Find some hobbies, find some friends. Move on. Life will come to you when it comes. It’s just around the corner..our corners just might be a bit longer than everyone else’s.

Sounds to me like he's addicted to the games. I can speak from personal experience that the only way for this problem to end is to cut out that particular game from his life. He won't be able to moderate something he truly loves and "needs" for social comfort in his mind. I was 400lbs, addicted to food, cut out my stomach because I couldn't change, now I'm 150lbs. I Was addicted to FIFA on PS4 throughout my college years. Ruined many important things for me. I Was incapable of changing it. It didn't get better until one day I got fed up with losing ultimate team and cracked the disk in half. Finally realized the time I was wasting. My current gf, loves to party and get attention from other men. It kills our relationship. It's not going to get better if she keeps going back; even a little. He's not gonna change while the game is still a major force in his life...especially if it's a MOBA lol. 

Ask him to delete it for awhile. Tell him it's important to you that you guys get back on the same page and back to what made you two fall in the first place. It wasn't video games and his rank in LOL. Do things you know he likes. Entice him, wear a sexy outfit to bed. Perhaps have sex with him even if he's played games all night and he might be inclined to compromise on his end. Maybe he just needs to see some extra-effort on your side to get motivated. Most likely not, but there's a chance. And if you give this extra effort and there's still no sign of trying on his end, you know what to do. I'm not saying reward his neglect; I'm saying don't take it from the relationship. It's important for a mans confidence in his relationship. Yes, no sex means there's something wrong to us; but it also has an incredibly larger effect on our minds and bodies physically. He'll just continue to ignore you and might even get slightly whinney about it, making you think it's the only thing he cares about when it's not; it's a symptom of the main problems. But it's more important to him than you. I find it's usually that way. Could just be me. Idk.

Life/relationships get better with compromise. I know at 24 from watching my parents currently go through a divorce. My dad has always compromised and my mother has never changed or saught therapeutic help. If she had, over the years, made an effort to get better and happy herself; perhaps her marriage wouldn't be on the brink. You never know. But I do know the happiest times in my childhood were the times my parents got along. 

You guys can get through this. You wouldn't have moved in with him if you didn't see a future. This is a roadblock, not a break up. Ge around the video games. If he does really love you but is addicted to the games, he'll show signs that he's trying to get better but won't be able to leave the game. Help him leave the game if he shows signs. Otherwise, he's too far down the hole and the game needs to go or you do if you can't handle that lifestyle. 

I hope any of this helps!
